title: ReadSurface
description: The shape of experiments/blic/read.sh output, as observed against this repository's 39 briefs. This schema is a description of the frozen instrument, not a contract it agreed to: read.sh is hand-rolled JSON with no schema of its own, so every field here was read out of the script and confirmed against a live snapshot. Where the instrument disagrees with the five-state vocabulary in docs/blc/briefs/README.md, this schema records what the instrument actually emits and the disagreement is carried in a description.

email.description: git config user.email, or empty when git has no identity configured.

Phase.title: Phase
Phase.description: One phase entry. Its state comes from the ledger status line and its label from the phase table; the two can disagree, which is BRIEFS-9, and the instrument reports both rather than correcting either.

id.description: Phase id as written in the status line: a letter for modern briefs, a digit for the earliest ones.

label.description: Phase label from the ledger's phase table. Empty for the oldest briefs, which have no table.

state.description: Raw phase state token. Usually one of pending / in-progress / done / skipped / blocked, but the instrument's tokenizer splits on whitespace, so a pointer containing a space leaks into this field as the truncated token "done(commit". Normalize before display.

pointer.description: Merge pointer, e.g. PR#45. Empty when the phase has none, and also empty when the tokenizer lost it to a space.

Brief.title: Brief
Brief.description: One numbered brief. Identity fields come from brief.md, state from ledger.md. A brief with no ledger is reported rather than skipped.

dir.description: Path relative to the repository root.

title.description: First H1 of brief.md, falling back to the slug.

state.description: Raw brief state from the status line. NOT the five-state vocabulary: for older briefs the merge pointer is glued on, e.g. "done(PR#11)" or "done(commit 92a7168)". Normalize before display or before comparing.

status_line.description: The whole status line, verbatim. Empty when the ledger has none, in which case state is "no-line".

owner.description: **Owner:** from the identity line. Empty when absent.

assignee.description: Owner, or Author when there is no Owner. The rule list-briefs.sh --owner uses.

mine.description: assignee equals the current git identity, case-insensitively.

created.description: **Created:** timestamp. Format varies across three years of convention.

closed.description: **Closed:** date from the ledger. Empty when the ledger records none, which for a done brief is the BRIEFS-11 judgment.

touched.description: Commit date of the last commit to touch the brief directory, ISO 8601 with offset. Empty when git knows nothing about the path.

Declaration.title: Declaration
Declaration.description: One contributor's claim on work picked up and not yet filed. Only files carrying at least one ## entry appear.

who.description: Declaration file basename, which is the contributor's git email.

Defect.title: Defect
Defect.description: One line of tools/validate-briefs.sh output, parsed. The gate's own judgment, not a second reading of it.

kind.description: judgment or violation, as the gate classified it.

subject.description: Usually the brief slug the judgment is about.

EventKind.title: EventKind
EventKind.description: How the instrument classified a commit. Closed set: read.sh assigns exactly these and falls through to "code" rather than guessing.

mine.description: True for every real event in this fixture: the repository has one author.

serial.description: Brief serial the commit names, or empty.

phase.description: Phase letter the commit names, or empty.

PeerEvent.title: PeerEvent
PeerEvent.description: One line of experiments/blic/peer-events.sh. Carries synthetic: true, which nothing removes. It has no "when": the generator emits none, so a consumer that wants a timestamp must stamp arrival and say so.

Snapshot.title: Snapshot
Snapshot.description: read.sh snapshot. Everything a console needs in one document.

generated.description: UTC timestamp of the read, not of the record.

repo.description: Absolute path of the repository root the instrument read.
